title: Blow-up of a Jacobian-weighted Lebesgue integral at a density point
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = Ambient n ℓ, ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ. Let C ⊆ ℝⁿ be compact, F: ℝⁿ → E continuous, J: ℝⁿ → ℝ continuous on C, w ∈ C, and A: ℝⁿ → E an injective continuous linear map with F differentiable at w with derivative A. Suppose c > 0 and c|v − w| ≤ |F(v) − F(w)| for all v ∈ C, and Lⁿ(C ∩ B_r(w))/Lⁿ(B_r(w)) → 1 in [0, ∞] as r ↓ 0 (closed balls). Then for every f ∈ C_c(E, ℝ), (tⁿ)⁻¹∫_C J(v)·f(t⁻¹(F(v) − F(w))) dLⁿ(v) → J(w)·∫_{ℝⁿ} f(A(u)) dLⁿ(u) as t ↓ 0.
